senses.gloss: (transpos. of שכשך, v. סִכְסֵךְ I) to entangle, catch, confound.

R. to IV, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>בית הסורים</he> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:14:1">ib.</cite>) <he>דהוא מְכַשְׂכֵּשׂ לברייתא כמן ביני סריאתא</he> he (the seducer) catches the people like one coming forth from between the bushes; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9">Midr.
